en: A hand‑colored panoramic view of a small European town set amid rolling fields and farmland. The town has dense red‑roofed houses, a prominent church with a tower at the center, and another large churchlike building with a tall spire on the right. The foreground shows cultivated fields; the background consists of gently rising hills and scattered trees. Printed German text appears in red along the bottom margin, with publisher information in smaller type.
